text_to_speech: hey guys i'm dustin ferguson back in 2009 i directed a movie called terror at black tree forest it was my first feature film and told the story of a group of college kids who went out hiking at black tree forest and end up in a game of cat and mouse with a hooded killer now 12 years later uk-based filmmaker and friend sam mason bell is directing the remake and he needs your help he's got a killer cast and some putrifying perks that you can check out in the description i've worked with sam many times in the past and i know that he'll deliver which is why i've also given him complete creative control of the film so if you can spare it toss this great team a few bucks and let's help make terror at black tree forest the best it can be

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hey guys, I'm Dustin Ferguson. Back in 2009, I directed a movie called Terror at
Black Tree Forest. It was my first feature film and told the story of a group of
college kids who went out hiking at Black Tree Forest and ended up in a game of
cat and mouse with a hooded killer. Now, 12 years later, UK-based filmmaker and
friend, Sam Mason-Bell is directing the remake and he needs your help. He's got a
killer cast and some putrifying perks that you can check out in the description.
I work with Sam many times in the past and I know that he'll deliver, which is
why I've also given him complete creative control of the film. So if you can
spare it, toss a great team a few bucks and let's help make Terror at Black
Tree Forest the best it can be.

youtube_description:
We currently have 32 days left of our indiegogo campaign for Terror At Black Tree Forest.
https://igg.me/at/black-tree-forest 
Dustin Ferguson the original director of the cult classic gives us a little video about the original and why you should invest in this remake!
